\begin{align}
(1 - z- z^2) s(z)
  &= \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} F_k z^k - \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} F_k z^{k+1} - \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} F_k z^{k+2} \\
  &= \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} F_k z^k - \sum_{k=1}^{\infty} F_{k-1} z^k - \sum_{k=2}^{\infty} F_{k-2} z^k \\
  &= 0z^0 + 1z^1 - 0z^1 + \sum_{k=2}^{\infty} (F_k - F_{k-1} - F_{k-2}) z^k \\
  &= z,
\end{align}
